apps.name: Synthia Admin Server Hard Bridge Mobile MCP
apps.notes: This is the active combined server base. It includes the newer mobile MCP capture and Kimi/ChatGPT bridge routes.

apps.name: Synthia Admin Server Applied POC Ledger
apps.notes: Older/lighter version of the hard-bridge server. Kept as reference because its ledger documents what is real vs placeholder.

apps.name: Synthia SASS Server
apps.notes: Included as a module, but its shipped server.js fails node --check because of unescaped nested template strings in generated code templates.

apps.name: MorphOS Android Real Linux
apps.notes: Native Android/Kotlin project for a local PRoot Alpine Linux environment. It is source-bundled here, not compiled into the Node server.

apps.name: AutoBuilder
apps.notes: Non-AI ingestion/build normalizer for app bundles. Exposed as source and ready to run from the combined package.

apps.name: Synthia Sovereign Studio
apps.notes: Best ready-to-go UI bundle found. It ships built PWA assets and an auto-launch pattern.

apps.name: Kimi Agent Phone-First Web Linux
apps.notes: Vite React source with package-lock. Local build did not finish within the audit window, so it is included as source.

apps.name: Synthia Server Main
apps.notes: Large server/reference system. Its package declares Node 24.x and heavier dependencies, so it is included as reference rather than the phone entrypoint.

apps.name: Synthia Browser
apps.notes: Vite React browser app source. Build before wrapping as static mobile UI.

apps.name: Synthia OS
apps.notes: TypeScript OS-style project with Termux setup script. Included as a source reference.

apps.name: MESSY Organism
apps.notes: Multi-package TypeScript monorepo. Useful as engine source but not a one-command phone artifact yet.

apps.name: Synthia Resonance Engine
apps.notes: Vite/TypeScript engine UI source.

apps.name: Synthia Termux APK Builder
apps.notes: Termux shell script that wraps HTML/JS assets into an Android WebView APK. The generated Java device-info JSON quote bug was patched in this assembled kit.

apps.name: Synthia Seedbox Swarm
apps.notes: Patched into the kit as a local, isolated head-start compiler pass. It runs once on Synthia startup, uses config/swarm-placement-rules.json for the rule-based intake pre-pass, and can promote APK output to /autoload.

apps.name: Cynthia Language Contact Organism Organs
apps.notes: Bundles Autoling, Diseminer, Klein LCM, LCM v2 chat/compiler, Synthia Python LCM, MESSY, Synthia OS Runtime, and the complete system source as Cynthia organs. Public requests route through Synthia; admin/backend changes route through controlled builder apply/rollback. LCM v2 and syntia.py are private/backend source material, not the public voice.

apps.name: Cynthia Organism Browser
apps.notes: Browser-facing Cynthia/Klein organism UI served by the same Synthia server.

apps.name: UNO Engine Premium
apps.notes: Vite app with a universal file ingestion, parser, repair, sandbox, repackager, and autoBuilder engine. Included as source/build material.

apps.name: Kimi Synth OS Mobile Linux
apps.notes: Prebuilt mobile Linux UI assets with terminal/files/browser/uploader style modules.

apps.name: SynthAi HumanDesign
apps.notes: C# Human Design object model and charting source. Useful source library, not part of the default Termux compile flow unless .NET is added.

apps.name: Original GitHub Source Inputs
apps.notes: Shallow-clones Tribler/superorganism-experiment, Tribler/self-compile-Android, and OpenHands/openhands into vendor-repos.
